## KEY POINT

Multiset protocols favoring high volumes of resistance training optimize the hypertrophic response. To avoid overtraining, people should increase volume progressively over the course of a training cycle and integrate periods of reduced training volume (i.e., deloads) regularly to facilitate the recovery process.
